; ModuleID = 'testdata/exact-copy/in.txt'
source_filename = "testdata/exact-copy/in.txt"
target datalayout = "e-p:64:64-i64:64-n32:64-S128"

%Pair = type { i32, ptr }

@escaped = global ptr null
@local_slot = internal global ptr null

declare ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64)

declare void @clobber(ptr)

declare noalias ptr @slot_alloc(i64)

; Function Attrs: nocallback nofree nounwind willreturn memory(argmem: readwrite)
declare void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr noalias nocapture writeonly, ptr noalias nocapture readonly, i64, i1 immarg) #0

define void @read_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  %p = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %p, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @exact_copy() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @alias() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  %alias = getelementptr ptr, ptr %slot, i64 0
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %alias, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @slot_address_escape() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr %slot, ptr @escaped, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @unknown_clobber() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p, ptr %slot, align 8
  call void @clobber(ptr %slot)
  ret void
}

define void @unsupported_reader() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  %q = load i64, ptr %slot, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @other_store() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr null, ptr %slot, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @global_destination() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %p, ptr @escaped, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @nonlocal_destination(ptr %dst) {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %p, ptr %dst, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @struct_field() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %object = alloca %Pair, align 8
  %field1 = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %field1, align 8
  %field2 = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  %q = load ptr, ptr %field2, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @array_element() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr], align 8
  %element1 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %element1, align 8
  %element2 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i32 0, i32 1
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element2, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @whole_struct_reader() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair, align 8
  %field = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %p, ptr %field, align 8
  %whole = load %Pair, ptr %object, align 8
  %q = extractvalue %Pair %whole, 1
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @read_before_store() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr null, ptr %slot, align 8
  %before = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr %before, ptr @escaped, align 8
  store ptr %p, ptr %slot, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @overwritten_copy() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr null, ptr %slot, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @selected_destination(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  %selected = select i1 %condition, ptr %slot, ptr %slot
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %selected, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @callee_reader() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  call void @read_slot(ptr %slot)
  ret void
}

; Function Attrs: norecurse
define void @read_before_store_norecurse() #1 {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr null, ptr %slot, align 8
  %before = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store ptr %before, ptr @escaped, align 8
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  ret void
}

define void @two_underlying_objects(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot1 = alloca ptr, align 8
  %slot2 = alloca ptr, align 8
  %selected = select i1 %condition, ptr %slot1, ptr %slot2
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %selected, align 8
  %q1 = load ptr, ptr %slot1, align 8
  %q2 = load ptr, ptr %slot2, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q1, align 1
  store i8 2, ptr %q2, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @finite_dynamic_offset(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr], align 8
  %index = select i1 %condition, i64 0, i64 1
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %p, ptr %element, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @unknown_dynamic_offset(i64 %index) {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr], align 8
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %p, ptr %element, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @memcpy_reader() {
entry:
  %p = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %source = alloca ptr, align 8
  %destination = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p, ptr %source, align 8
  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %destination, ptr %source, i64 8, i1 false)
  %q = load ptr, ptr %destination, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @internal_global_copy() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr @local_slot, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr @local_slot, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @noalias_object_copy() {
entry:
  %p.stack = alloca i8, i64 8, align 1
  %slot = call noalias ptr @slot_alloc(i64 8)
  store ptr %p.stack, ptr %slot, align 8
  %q = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 8
  store i8 1, ptr %q, align 1
  ret void
}

attributes #0 = { nocallback nofree nounwind willreturn memory(argmem: readwrite) }
attributes #1 = { norecurse }
